title: The Somerton Man and the Tamam Shud Mystery
description: In 1948, an unidentified man was found dead on Somerton Beach in Adelaide, Australia. A scrap reading Tamam Shud and a concealed code made the case internationally famous; later DNA research identified him as Carl Webb.
